findings.issue: Indices 65–69 give full credit to APARELHO OCULAR > Amaurose in addition to Escotomas. The only support is the source wording “perda total ou parcial da visão”. Each utterance describes a small, circumscribed part of the image that is missing while the rest is seen, which the same source lists as a separate entry (Escotomas: “Falha ou ponto cego no campo visual onde a visão fica parcial ou totalmente ausente”). The record opened for this review (MeSH D001766, Blindness, which lists Amaurosis as an entry term) is about inability to see or loss of visual perception, and MeSH D012607 defines a scotoma as a localized defect bordered by normal vision. In this batch the mapping is also one-directional: the Amaurose stories (indices 100–109) do not accept Escotomas. The reviewer could not confirm that a student answering Amaurose for these utterances should receive full credit.
findings.resolution: Hold the five stories for a teaching decision. The sentences themselves clearly match Escotomas and no un-keyed term fits as well.
findings.requiredStoryChange: Text not rewritten by the reviewer and no text change requested. Either (a) remove APARELHO OCULAR > Amaurose from acceptedContextIds and acceptedPathEvidence and edit story.rationale so it no longer presents Amaurose as an accepted answer; or (b) obtain a teaching decision that Amaurose’s “perda parcial da visão” covers a small circumscribed gap, record it, and decide whether Amaurose stories accept Escotomas in return. Any of these needs a new independent review.

findings.issue: Indices 80–84 give full credit to APARELHO OCULAR > Secreção in addition to Epífora. The source line for ocular Secreção is a recording instruction (“anotar aspecto e quantidade”), not a definition, and the evidence entries for this path carry no referenceIds. The utterances do state aspect and amount, but of tears; whether tears count as ocular secretion is not stated in the source, which has a separate entry for excess tears. The batch maps this boundary in one direction only: the ocular Secreção stories with clear or watery fluid (indices 41, 44, 49) accept only Secreção. At the time of this run, content/reviews/interrogatorio-batch-009.json (another reviewer) holds ic-orgaos-dos-sentidos-aparelho-ocular-secrecao-story-02 and ic-orgaos-dos-sentidos-aparelho-ocular-secrecao-story-05 because Epífora may be a missing path there. The reviewer could not confirm that a student answering Secreção for these utterances should receive full credit.
findings.resolution: Hold the five stories for a teaching decision. The sentences themselves clearly match Epífora and no un-keyed term fits as well.
findings.requiredStoryChange: Text not rewritten by the reviewer and no text change requested. findings.issue: Indices 70–79 accept Turvação visual and Acuidade visual. The reviewer confirms both: the source asks of Acuidade visual only “Preservada ou não?”, and each utterance reports sharpness or detail discrimination worse than usual. At indices 75, 77 and 78 the Acuidade visual support is only wording about sharpness or clarity (no reading or recognition failure is stated). Amaurose (“perda total ou parcial da visão”) is not accepted by these stories; the reviewer agrees, because no utterance says that vision was lost and several say the whole image is still seen (indices 73, 75, 78, 79).
findings.resolution: Pass. A teaching reviewer may want to confirm that a student who answers Amaurose for a blur-only utterance is scored as incorrect, consistently with whatever is decided for B011-01.

findings.issue: As descrições da apostila são mais curtas e, em parte, mais amplas que as dos vocabulários consultados. Escotomas: a apostila fala em falha ou ponto cego; o MeSH (D012607) fala em defeito localizado cercado por visão normal. Amaurose: a apostila inclui perda parcial; o MeSH (D001766, Blindness) trata Amaurosis como termo de entrada de cegueira. Acuidade visual: a apostila só pergunta se está preservada; o MeSH (D014792) fala em clareza ou nitidez e em ver detalhes finos. Epífora: a apostila fala em excesso de lágrimas; nenhuma fala estabelece o mecanismo.
findings.resolution: Accept source-based descriptive recognition for the confirmed paths. Cause, laterality beyond what is said, measurement and any underlying condition remain unestablished.

Does “parcial” cover (a) a small blind spot (Escotomas stories, currently yes in the batch), (b) blurred vision (Turvação visual stories, currently no)?
